follow-up time: From spinal block placement to delivery
outcome: Maximal drop in systolic blood pressure
cohort: 160 healthy women undergoing elective cesarean delivery with spinal anesthesia
finding: Vasopressor use (total phenylephrine dose) was lower in the colloid preloading group than in the crystalloid co-loading group, but differences in all outcome measures were minimal and likely clinically insignificant.
